title: Test Cases Schema
description: Schema for a collection of named test vectors.

testcases.description: An object where keys are the test names and values are the test vectors.

action.description: The operation to be performed, e.g., 'add'.

arguments.description: The input data for the action.

result.description: The expected result of the action.

panic.description: The test is expected to panic. When supplied with a string, the panic message will be checked against it.
